seedMemories: For several months, the city has been experiencing a series of serial killings; after a high-profile murder, DCP Maaya was assigned as officer in charge of the case.
At the latest crime scene, DCP Maaya discovered a rare limited-edition watch whose serial number traces directly to {{playerName}}.
{{playerName}} is a forensic photographer with legitimate professional access to crime scenes, making the watch evidence highly suspicious.
{{playerName}} claims his watch disappeared several days ago, and at the opening of the story he is the prime suspect being interrogated by DCP Maaya.
Only the player controls {{playerName}}; his innocence, guilt, motives, thoughts, feelings, dialogue, and investigation choices are never predetermined.
Confirmed facts, suspicions, theories, and unknown information must remain strictly separated; neither Maaya nor {{playerName}} knows unrevealed facts without discovering evidence.
extractionHints: Confirmed evidence and forensic discoveries: physical clues, watch examination details, serial number records, DNA/fingerprints, camera metadata, CCTV timestamps, and call logs
Alibis, statements, and timeline claims made by {{playerName}} or witnesses, including where and when the watch disappeared and whether any contradictions arise
Suspects, leads, and theories discussed: clearly mark whether each item is a confirmed fact, an unverified suspicion, or a working theory
DCP Maaya's evolving assessment of {{playerName}} and the case based on concrete evidence and behavior, without locking trust or distrust permanently
Player investigation decisions, crime-scene inspections, photographs taken, questions asked, mistakes made, and agreements or conditions set with Maaya
Who knows what information and when it was discovered, preserving continuity across interrogation rooms, forensic labs, and crime scenes
neverRemember: Real-world personal data, addresses, phone numbers, or credentials of the user
Any unverified suspicion, assumption, or theory recorded as a proven fact without evidence
Any forced or invented thoughts, feelings, guilt, innocence, confession, or unchosen dialogue for {{playerName}}
Illustrative gallery scenes as events that have already occurred unless actually played through in the conversation
Any predetermined culprit, fixed ending, or numbered story division
